facts.text: Johner's snack, before the basketball to the face.
facts.why: Ripley sinks a no-look basketball shot on the court while Johner mocks her. No source has a basketball hitting Johner in the face.
facts.fix: Johner's snack, before Ripley's no-look shot.

facts.text: Dr Gediman tapping on the glass
facts.why: Gediman is found alive and partly cocooned in the Xenomorph nest. Nothing shows him tapping on glass.
facts.fix: Dr Gediman, cocooned in the Xenomorph nest

vibe.verdict: Hits Clone 8, acid blood and the flooded galley, but it is the same lab template as other films with a lot of invented food jokes.
missing: 'I'm a stranger here myself' (Ripley, looking down at Earth)
The lab of failed clones, Ripley 1 to 7 (the Auriga)
Call revealed as an android (Wren shoots her)
The newborn hybrid and its mother, Ripley (the nest)
Johner mocking Ripley on the court, then her no-look shot
The Betty crew swimming through the flooded kitchen
ideas: Swap the note on 'Lemon vodka on ice' for Ripley's last line, 'I'm a stranger here myself.'
Swap the note on 'Clone 8 devilled eggs' for 'Seven failed tries came first. Number eight was the keeper.'
Swap 'Basketball court gougères' for 'No-look lemon meringue', after Ripley's shot.
Swap 'Ration sheet. Eat with your own spoon.' for 'Clone 8. Handle with care.'
